failure_modes: Endgame effects near a known termination
gloss: Cooperation holds when interaction is repeated without a known end
invariants: Cooperation depends on expected future interaction
mechanism: In repeated games, tit-for-tat cooperation breaks down when the number of rounds is fixed and known, since defection in the last round unravels earlier ones. It survives when the end is unknown. Small communities in which people will meet for decades stay cooperative for the same reason, unlike strangers at a train station.
